page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i2gne.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. This KVM-hypervised instance features 4 physical cores and 8 vCPUs, with 2 threads per core. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB per core. The hardware configuration includes a bundled 959 GB local SSD storage drive and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps. The processor supports AVX, AVX512F, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA instruction sets, though it lacks newer extensions like AVX512_VNNI and AMX.

Benchmark data indicates that the ecs.i2gne.2xlarge generally operates in the lower performance tiers for compute and memory tasks. Single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, alongside Geekbench scores, place the instance in the bottom 25% of tested hardware. Memory read bandwidth is also weak, though large-block uncached write bandwidth achieves an average rating. While Passmark CPU and extended instruction tests reach average performance levels, database operations, Redis SET operations, and static web serving throughput remain in the bottom 25%. LLM inference speeds are average for very small models but drop to poor for medium models.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.i2gne.2xlarge offers a balanced resource density for workloads that require dedicated CPU allocation and substantial local SSD storage without demanding high-performance compute. The bundled 959 GB SSD provides a cost-effective storage tier directly attached to the instance. This server is best suited for moderate database workloads, general-purpose file serving, basic data processing, and lightweight application hosting where local storage capacity is prioritized over raw processing speed.
